reddit.title: Improving the Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share some updates on the music system in Provincia! We've implemented a long equal-power crossfade for our day, night, title, and combat music beds, which means you won't experience hard cuts anymore. This improvement enhances the overall atmosphere and immersion in the game. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
